rationale.text: Surface-area limitation is the binding constraint in the current process, and the proposed coating is the only route we can execute with the platform in hand.

question.text: whether a 42 nm porous coating raises uptake rate three-fold

innovation.text: Unlike prior work that reports endpoint uptake, this proposal measures the rate at which the coating changes it, under paired controls.

foundation_items.name: coating rig
foundation_items.relation: the same rig makes the proposed coatings

timeline.deliverable: coating protocol and first paired dataset

budget.basis: 60 runs at the supplier catalogue unit scale; amount pending finance

budget_justification: each line is costed from current supplier quotes

architecture.background: Current porous coatings are limited by surface area.
architecture.gap: Endpoint uptake is reported, but the time-resolved rate is unknown.
architecture.question: whether a 42 nm coating changes the uptake rate under paired controls
architecture.hypothesis: the coating raises the rate at least three-fold without selectivity loss
architecture.objectives: three measurable objectives in the work plan
architecture.content: coating synthesis, rate measurement and control comparison
architecture.technical_route: synthesise, characterise, then measure paired samples
architecture.outcomes: a rate-ratio estimate and a reusable measurement protocol

science_question.central_question: whether 42 nm porosity changes uptake rate rather than only endpoint uptake
science_question.hypothesis: the rate ratio exceeds three against the uncoated substrate
science_question.boundary: one material class, 24 h, paired controls, no in vivo claim
science_question.falsifiability: a rate ratio at or below one falsifies the central hypothesis

innovations.text: Time-resolved rate measurement under paired controls.
innovations.difference: measures rate trajectories in the same samples instead of one endpoint
innovations.why_hard: requires stable paired sampling without changing the coating
innovations.feasibility_evidence: M1 pilot run and the existing coating rig

key_questions.text: Does the coating change the uptake trajectory or only its endpoint?
key_questions.answer_measure: paired rate ratio with a confidence interval

feasibility.technical: the coating rig already deposits 40 nm films
feasibility.team: one materials lead and one measurement operator
feasibility.resource: existing rig plus consumables in the given budget
feasibility.time: two synthesis campaigns fit the annual plan

applicant_evidence.gap_note: The applicant's independent preliminary results are not in the supplied materials; only external published evidence and team platform access are claimed.

outcomes.assessment: rate ratio reproduces under a second operator

risks.trigger: two pore collapses in one week

ethics.scope_explanation: in vitro materials only; no human, animal or personal data

output_contract.element_matrix: paragraph to element to evidence map

proposal_chapter: Synthetic demo: the chapter text is assembled from the seven element blocks.
evidence_gaps: Applicant-owned preliminary results are not supplied in this synthetic demo.
